# Blackout Merchandise

> Blackout Merchandise helps artists, brands and creators design, source and sell premium merchandise.

Membership is by application. Blackout Merchandise is based in Barcelona, Spain.

## Pages on blackoutmerch.example

- /: the door, with sign-in for members and the application.
- /faq/: short answers about Blackout Merchandise.
- /watch/: a short film about one run, from brief to doorstep.
- /agents/: connecting your own AI agent over MCP. Opening to members soon.
